findings.reproduction_procedure: Inspect provider detection loop when multiple specialized adapters match.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: detect_framework_provider iterates over get_providers() and returns the first non-generic provider returning true. Currently only angular_ngrx and generic exist.
findings.expected_behavior: Sequential resolution is correct for 2 providers; multi-framework composite dispatch or priority weighting may be desirable when React/Vue adapters are introduced in future stages.
findings.recommended_remediation: Preserve current clean fallback architecture. Consider composite framework providers when multiple frontend frameworks co-exist in mono-repos.

findings.reproduction_procedure: Inspect container module matching rule in compiler query routing.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: Matches files ending with .module.ts, app.module.ts, core.module.ts, main.ts, index.ts, mod.rs, lib.rs.
findings.expected_behavior: Filename suffix heuristic accurately isolates aggregator God modules in Angular and Rust.
findings.recommended_remediation: In future ecosystem adapters, supplement filename matching with AST export density metrics (e.g. >20 re-exported modules).

findings.reproduction_procedure: Inspect engram_get_context parameters and responses in src/mcp.rs.
findings.actual_observed_behavior: engram_inspect_symbol returns bounded excerpts and member structures; engram_get_context has not yet implemented Phase 4E priority-tier token budget packing and omission manifests.
findings.expected_behavior: Scheduled for Phase 4E implementation as mandated by the project remediation specification.
findings.recommended_remediation: Implement Phase 4E context budget guard, token counter abstraction, contracted signatures by default, and structured omission manifests.
findings.verification_test: Phase 4E implementation and Phase 4E.1 test suite.
